async def act(page):
    """
    From the Manage Products grid, find the Frankie Sweatshirt product, open its edit page (via relative goto to avoid unpredictable link-click navigation),
    open the Associated/Configurations area, and attempt to add the Color "Blue" for sizes S and M (create associated simples / configurations if needed),
    then save the product (Save click is the final action).

    This is a best-effort script that uses accessibility-role selectors and .select_option() for <select> elements where applicable.
    """
    # Small helper to safely click any button/link by several possible names
    async def try_click_any(role, names):
        for n in names:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role(role, name=n).click()
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    # 0) Close any blocking popup if present by trying common close controls
    # Try buttons with common names, and press Escape as fallback
    popup_close_names = ["Close", "×", "Close dialog", "Dismiss", "OK", "Cancel"]
    await try_click_any("button", popup_close_names)
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 1) Ensure we're on Manage Products grid (we're already here per current state).
    # 2) Trigger the Search to apply any existing Name filter (there is a Search button in the UI)
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except Exception:
        # If Search isn't clickable or not needed, just continue
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 3) Try to locate the product link for "Frankie Sweatshirt" and obtain its href so we can goto it.
    product_href = None
    try:
        link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt")
        # Attempt to read href attribute
        href = await link.get_attribute("href")
        if href:
            product_href = href
    except Exception:
        # try partial match
        try:
            link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie")
            href = await link.get_attribute("href")
            if href:
                product_href = href
        except Exception:
            product_href = None

    # If we couldn't find a direct product link, try to find the Edit link in the row containing Frankie
    if not product_href:
        try:
            # Find a row that contains a cell with the product name
            row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name=lambda t: t and "Frankie Sweatshirt" in t))
            edit_link = row.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")
            href = await edit_link.get_attribute("href")
            if href:
                product_href = href
        except Exception:
            product_href = None

    # If still not found, try to click the product name link (this would navigate) as a last resort
    if not product_href:
        try:
            # Make this click the final action because it will navigate away
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
            return
        except Exception:
            # We cannot proceed reliably
            return

    # 4) Navigate directly to the product edit page using the href we've retrieved (use relative goto when possible)
    # Normalize href: if it's absolute, use it as-is; Playwright accepts relative too
    await page.goto(product_href)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 5) On the product edit page, close any popups again if present
    await try_click_any("button", popup_close_names)
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 6) Open Associated / Configurations tab (try several possible labels)
    assoc_tab_candidates = [
        "Associated Products",
        "Associated Products / Variations",
        "Associated",
        "Configurations",
        "Configurable Product Variations",
        "Associated Items",
        "Product Variations",
    ]
    assoc_opened = False
    for name in assoc_tab_candidates:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("tab", name=name).click()
            assoc_opened = True
            break
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name=name).click()
                assoc_opened = True
                break
            except Exception:
                try:
                    await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
                    assoc_opened = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
    # wait for UI
    if assoc_opened:
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 7) Try to launch the Create Configurations / Create Products flow
    create_names = [
        "Create Configurations",
        "Create Configurations...",
        "Create Products",
        "Create Product",
        "Add Product",
        "Add New Product",
        "Add",
        "Create Variations",
    ]
    create_triggered = False
    for name in create_names:
        try:
            # Try clicking within a possible section to disambiguate
            # Prefer to click button scoped under the page (top-level) to avoid ambiguity
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            create_triggered = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 8) If a multi-step wizard appears, attempt to select attributes Color and Size and choose values
    # Try common step flows: pick attributes, then pick values, then generate
    # Step: pick attribute checkboxes (e.g., Color, Size)
    try:
        # Try to check combobox or checkbox labelled "Color" and "Size" in attribute selection
        # Some flows present checkboxes instead of comboboxes
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Color").check()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Size").check()
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Click Next/Continue to go to values selection
    await try_click_any("button", ["Next", "Continue", "Next Step", "Continue to Step 2"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # 9) In values selection, choose Color=Blue and Sizes S and M
    # Color might be a combobox or a list of checkboxes
    try:
        # Try combobox selection for Color
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option(label="Blue")
        except Exception:
            # Try checkboxes for color options
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Blue").check()
            except Exception:
                pass

        # For Size, try selecting S and M via combobox (multi-select) or checkboxes
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label="S")
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="S").check()
            except Exception:
                pass
        # Also add M
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label="M")
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="M").check()
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 10) Proceed to generate configurations / create products step
    await try_click_any("button", ["Next", "Generate", "Create", "Create Products", "Generate Products", "Create Configurations", "Finish"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1200)

    # 11) If there is an Apply/OK in the modal, press it
    await try_click_any("button", ["Apply", "OK", "Done", "Finish", "Create"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 12) Final: Save the main product (this will navigate away) - make this the last action
    # Try the typical Save button names
    save_names = ["Save", "Save and Continue Edit", "Save Product"]
    for name in save_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            # After clicking Save, do not perform any additional selectors per instructions
            return
        except Exception:
            continue

    # If no save button found via roles, try clicking any button with text Save inexactly
    try:
        # fallback using get_by_role with name containing Save might not be supported, so try one more label
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue").click()
        return
    except Exception:
        # Could not find Save; finish without saving
        return

    From the Manage Products grid, find the Frankie Sweatshirt product, open its edit page (via relative goto to avoid unpredictable link-click navigation),
    open the Associated/Configurations area, and attempt to add the Color "Blue" for sizes S and M (create associated simples / configurations if needed),
    then save the product (Save click is the final action).

    This is a best-effort script that uses accessibility-role selectors and .select_option() for <select> elements where applicable.
    """
    # Small helper to safely click any button/link by several possible names
    async def try_click_any(role, names):
        for n in names:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role(role, name=n).click()
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    # 0) Close any blocking popup if present by trying common close controls
    # Try buttons with common names, and press Escape as fallback
    popup_close_names = ["Close", "×", "Close dialog", "Dismiss", "OK", "Cancel"]
    await try_click_any("button", popup_close_names)
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 1) Ensure we're on Manage Products grid (we're already here per current state).
    # 2) Trigger the Search to apply any existing Name filter (there is a Search button in the UI)
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except Exception:
        # If Search isn't clickable or not needed, just continue
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 3) Try to locate the product link for "Frankie Sweatshirt" and obtain its href so we can goto it.
    product_href = None
    try:
        link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt")
        # Attempt to read href attribute
        href = await link.get_attribute("href")
        if href:
            product_href = href
    except Exception:
        # try partial match
        try:
            link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie")
            href = await link.get_attribute("href")
            if href:
                product_href = href
        except Exception:
            product_href = None

    # If we couldn't find a direct product link, try to find the Edit link in the row containing Frankie
    if not product_href:
        try:
            # Find a row that contains a cell with the product name
            row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_role("cell", name=lambda t: t and "Frankie Sweatshirt" in t))
            edit_link = row.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")
            href = await edit_link.get_attribute("href")
            if href:
                product_href = href
        except Exception:
            product_href = None

    # If still not found, try to click the product name link (this would navigate) as a last resort
    if not product_href:
        try:
            # Make this click the final action because it will navigate away
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Frankie Sweatshirt").click()
            return
        except Exception:
            # We cannot proceed reliably
            return

    # 4) Navigate directly to the product edit page using the href we've retrieved (use relative goto when possible)
    # Normalize href: if it's absolute, use it as-is; Playwright accepts relative too
    await page.goto(product_href)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # 5) On the product edit page, close any popups again if present
    await try_click_any("button", popup_close_names)
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 6) Open Associated / Configurations tab (try several possible labels)
    assoc_tab_candidates = [
        "Associated Products",
        "Associated Products / Variations",
        "Associated",
        "Configurations",
        "Configurable Product Variations",
        "Associated Items",
        "Product Variations",
    ]
    assoc_opened = False
    for name in assoc_tab_candidates:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("tab", name=name).click()
            assoc_opened = True
            break
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("link", name=name).click()
                assoc_opened = True
                break
            except Exception:
                try:
                    await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
                    assoc_opened = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue
    # wait for UI
    if assoc_opened:
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 7) Try to launch the Create Configurations / Create Products flow
    create_names = [
        "Create Configurations",
        "Create Configurations...",
        "Create Products",
        "Create Product",
        "Add Product",
        "Add New Product",
        "Add",
        "Create Variations",
    ]
    create_triggered = False
    for name in create_names:
        try:
            # Try clicking within a possible section to disambiguate
            # Prefer to click button scoped under the page (top-level) to avoid ambiguity
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            create_triggered = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 8) If a multi-step wizard appears, attempt to select attributes Color and Size and choose values
    # Try common step flows: pick attributes, then pick values, then generate
    # Step: pick attribute checkboxes (e.g., Color, Size)
    try:
        # Try to check combobox or checkbox labelled "Color" and "Size" in attribute selection
        # Some flows present checkboxes instead of comboboxes
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Color").check()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Size").check()
        except Exception:
            pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Click Next/Continue to go to values selection
    await try_click_any("button", ["Next", "Continue", "Next Step", "Continue to Step 2"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(700)

    # 9) In values selection, choose Color=Blue and Sizes S and M
    # Color might be a combobox or a list of checkboxes
    try:
        # Try combobox selection for Color
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option(label="Blue")
        except Exception:
            # Try checkboxes for color options
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Blue").check()
            except Exception:
                pass

        # For Size, try selecting S and M via combobox (multi-select) or checkboxes
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label="S")
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="S").check()
            except Exception:
                pass
        # Also add M
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option(label="M")
        except Exception:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="M").check()
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 10) Proceed to generate configurations / create products step
    await try_click_any("button", ["Next", "Generate", "Create", "Create Products", "Generate Products", "Create Configurations", "Finish"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1200)

    # 11) If there is an Apply/OK in the modal, press it
    await try_click_any("button", ["Apply", "OK", "Done", "Finish", "Create"])
    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 12) Final: Save the main product (this will navigate away) - make this the last action
    # Try the typical Save button names
    save_names = ["Save", "Save and Continue Edit", "Save Product"]
    for name in save_names:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=name).click()
            # After clicking Save, do not perform any additional selectors per instructions
            return
        except Exception:
            continue

    # If no save button found via roles, try clicking any button with text Save inexactly
    try:
        # fallback using get_by_role with name containing Save might not be supported, so try one more label
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue").click()
        return
    except Exception:
        # Could not find Save; finish without saving
        return
